title: [GMCP 203.023.02] Production path: Service adapters and generated MCP surfaces
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-023-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, command and native-library adapters can generate reviewable MCP tools/resources with stable names, precise schemas, pagination, auth mapping, rate limits, idempotency and redaction. Generated artifacts are reproducible, diffable and policy-scanned; unsupported semantics fail generation rather than producing unsafe generic shells. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
